description: Ubuntu 24.04 OpenSSL FIPS provider implementation providing cryptographic services to Linux user space software components. The module was tested with 64 bit word size. The following cipher implementation is covered: SSH KDF using CPACF SHA implementation.

oes.name: Ubuntu 24.04 on z16 on IBM Z System Telum
details: Processor Telum (processor family S390) from IBM

capabilities: Hash Algorithm: SHA-1, SHA2-224, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512
